plugins.name: silverplan
plugins.description: The Silverplan advisory agency in your assistant: an orchestrator and seven specialist skills (pensions, LPP, 3rd pillar, mortgage, taxation, estate, life insurance) backed by your financial dossier and the deterministic Swiss projection engine. The figures come from the engine, never from the model.

plugins.name: silverplan-pro
plugins.description: The Silverplan agency for pension advisors: an orchestrator, the seven business skills applied to YOUR clients' dossiers, and the skills of the advisor's trade (portfolio review, meeting preparation, onboarding and document collection). Backed by the deterministic Swiss projection engine: you prepare and decide, the agent signs nothing.
